problem: Signed Third Autocorrelation / Autoconvolution Constant C_1d (Phi_3)
definition: C_1d = inf_{f != 0, supp(f) subset [-1/4, 1/4]} max_{t in R} |(f * f)(t)| / (integral_{-1/4}^{1/4} f(x) dx)^2
method: Zero-smoothing dyadic prolongation (P=3200 -> 6400) + Exact Dense Cholesky Full-Hessian Newton (beta continuation 5e3 -> 1.2e7)
